# Analog Heat (MKI, MKII, +FX)

Data last verified: 2026-11-05

> No community firmware mod found yet (2026-10-31). Generic tooling covers it: elektron-firmware-tool (firmware container), Elektroid (sample/SysEx manager) and Overwitch (Overbridge audio on Linux) list Analog Heat MKI/MKII/+FX. screendump names it as 'not implemented'. Neither the Lapin list nor altstrument.org has a firmware entry for it. Last official OS we saw on elektron.se: Analog Heat MKI/MKII OS 1.22 (2024-10-16); the +FX has its own OS (release notes last updated 2024-10-16) and MKII firmware is not interchangeable with +FX.

## Details

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### Elektron Firmware Download List

Forum thread listing stock firmware. Not fetched in detail yet. Remember: this aggregator links to stock firmware sources but never hosts them.

_Sources: forum overview_

### Elek View (screen viewer in the browser)

Shows a device's screen in the browser over Web MIDI, using the stock RPC screen request (an HTML port of screendump). Tested on a Digitakt II and a Model:Cycles; the author reports an Analog Heat MKII working. Nothing else may hold the MIDI port. GPL-3.0. Found on elektronmods.com 2026-11-03.

_Related: port of `screendump` (README: a .html implementation of jakobbak/screendump) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: elektronmods.com thread 93, README, index.html_

### Elektroid

Sample and SysEx manager. README device list includes Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX, Digitakt I and II, Digitone I/II/Keys, Syntakt (also Analog Four/Rytm/Keys, Model:Cycles/Samples, Monomachine MKII). GPL-3.0, 2,506 commits, 425 stars. No version/date visible.

_Latest seen (2026-10-31, secondary directories): altstrument: v3.4 (2026-08-22) adds Syntakt samples; also KORG logue and Monomachine; GPL-3.0-or-later; author's tool does not change firmware._

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Overwitch

Multitrack Overbridge audio on Linux. Supports Overbridge 2 devices incl. Analog Heat, Heat MKII and Heat +FX, Digitakt I/II, Digitone I/II/Keys, Syntakt. Overbridge 1 devices (Analog Four MKI, Analog Keys, Rytm MKI) not supported. GPL-3.0, 671 commits.

_Latest seen (2026-10-31, secondary directories): altstrument: v2.2 (2025-12-21), GPL-3.0-or-later, JACK clients streaming multitrack Overbridge 2 audio._

_Related: builds on `dtdump` (README: based on the Overbridge USB reverse engineering in dtdump) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Analog Heat FX+ MultiMode (beta 0.1)

The first public custom firmware announcement for the Heat +FX (2026-11-02): screenshots only; features, OS version, licence and a unit test are not stated, a GitHub link is promised. Origin: elektronmods.com, read 2026-11-03.
